transient_health_mode.title: Mode
transient_health_mode.description: Shadow records health evidence. Active applies the configured thresholds through MTC core.

transient_health_window_ms.title: Evidence window (ms)
transient_health_window_ms.description: Aligned health-evidence window managed by MTC core. Active mode uses migration 104 and the short-window runtime.

min_samples.title: Samples before opening
min_samples.description: Conclusive samples required before the opening threshold can apply.

open_micros.title: Opening threshold (EWMA ppm)
open_micros.description: Opens transient health at or above this failure EWMA after min_samples.

recover_micros.title: Recovery threshold (EWMA ppm)
recover_micros.description: Restores transient health at or below this failure EWMA. Set it at or below open_micros.

min_probe_successes.title: Probe successes before recovery
min_probe_successes.description: Consecutive successful probes required before recovery.

cooldown_ms.title: Cooldown (ms)
cooldown_ms.description: Delay between transient attempts or probes.

recovery_wait_ms.title: In-request recovery wait (ms)
recovery_wait_ms.description: Maximum recovery wait within the original request deadline.
